nodes.description: CLN8 encodes a multipass transmembrane protein of the TRAM-LAG1-CLN8 (TLC) domain family that resides in the endoplasmic reticulum and ER-Golgi intermediate compartment, where it functions as an ER-to-Golgi cargo receptor delivering soluble lysosomal enzymes and participates in membrane phospholipid remodeling. Loss of CLN8 function impairs lysosomal enzyme trafficking and lipid homeostasis, initiating the neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis disease process.
